name: Event e Ikou! Sono 1
original_name: イベントへ行こう!その1
source:
Go to an event and have sex with cosplayers!

So much so that you could mistake it for jumping out of the work.
A must-see for girls who have become their favorite characters.

[Translated From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ058560.html]DLsite[/url]]

Features [url=http://anidb.net/perl-bin/animedb.pl?show=character&charid=2098]Kan'u Unchou[/url] from Ikkitousen.
